content:
#1 There was a disk space issue on the nLab server this evening. I noticed it only upon trying to access the nForum home page (the nLab was still working), but it may have affected other things as well. I have cleared some space for now.

There is tons of space in the /home directory, but / was full.

[Edit: the main cause was obscure (heap files produced when ElasticSearch, which we experimented with for metrics/a dashboard, ran out of memory last year). MySQL creates some files taking up a few GB as well, but there is still plenty of space for that now that the ElasticSearch heap files have been removed. The issue should not recur.]
subject: Disk space issue (resolved now)
